description: List all podcasts in the catalog, optionally filtered by category.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of {pid, title, host, category, subscribed}.

description: Retrieve full podcast metadata by pid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full podcast record plus a subscribed flag.

description: Subscribe to a podcast so new episodes are surfaced.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {podcast_id, subscribed: true}.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {podcast_id, subscribed: false}.

description: List episodes, optionally scoped to a single podcast. Sorted by published_at descending.

podcast_id.description: Optional podcast identifier to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of episode summaries.

description: Retrieve the full episode record by eid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full episode including description and audio_url.

description: Search episodes by keyword across title and description.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching episode summaries.

description: List the current playback queue ordered by position ascending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of queue items.

description: Append an episode to the end of the playback queue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new queue item.

description: Remove an item from the playback queue by qid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {qid, removed: true}.

description: Move a queue item to a specific position, renumbering the rest.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the reordered queue.

description: List playback progress for all episodes with recorded progress.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of progress records.

description: Update seconds_played for an episode. Auto-marks completed if seconds_played reaches duration.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated progress record.

description: Force-mark an episode as fully played.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the completed progress record.

description: List all downloaded episodes sorted by downloaded_at descending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of download records.

description: Download an episode for offline listening. Fails if already downloaded.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new download record.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {did, deleted: true}.

description: Return aggregate podcast stats: totals, queue size, completion count, download size.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output contains aggregate counts and totals.
